gen-gf-gabarito-fs-fira-sans: A single-nib look runs through Gabarito, its terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. And Fira Sans, with its larger x-height, can sit a touch smaller than expected.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-science-gothic: Gabarito draws everything with what feels like one nib, its terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. Science Gothic, stroke ends set far apart, sits happily at modest size.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-syncopate: Single-nib swagger: Gabarito cuts its terminals open so the counters flow outward. Syncopate handles the quiet work, holding a technical-pen steadiness with spacing like rungs on a rope ladder.
gen-gf-gabarito-montserrat: Montserrat reads with plenty of white space leading into each curve, its oversized e and a counters gliding under the eye. Gabarito's one-nib terminals, cut open, supply the lively edge.
gen-gf-gabarito-satoshi: Gabarito has a drawn-with-one-nib look, its terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. But Satoshi's soaring x-height sets up a lowercase-height contrast, which is the best thing about this pair.
gen-gf-gabarito-switzer: Single-nib swagger: Gabarito cuts its terminals open so the counters flow outward. Switzer, tubular and wire-like with a tall waist line, would read smoothly and easily, paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-gabarito-work-sans: Work Sans sets a high mean line and c tips that never creep toward touching. And Gabarito's one-nib terminals cut open are what make the pairing feel so lively and distinct.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-abeezee: Wide, round and commanding: Goldman sets its letters widely with generous clearance. ABeeZee steps in behind it with softer rounded-nib strokes and terminals that finish well clear of the stem.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-alexandria: Bold, widely set Goldman has round forms like open parentheses and lowercase large against its capitals. Alexandria, a tall-bodied sans with open c terminals and short stems, keeps paragraphs reading cleanly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-anek-devanagari: Goldman sets its round, parenthesis-like letters wide with generous clearance, and its lowercase looms large next to the capitals. Anek Devanagari matches that openness, its mouths distinctly open and middle zone tall.
